title: KestrelCare Claims Limits Card: Visit Limits, Aggregate Limits and Labor Rate Caps
content:
KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts limit what a repair claim can pay per visit and over the life of the plan, cap the labor rate recognized in a repair estimate, and set whether diagnostic time is paid and whether the deductible is waived at a Kestrel network facility. The card lists the figures for every coverage level.

| Coverage level | Per-repair-visit limit (USD, after the deductible) | Aggregate limit of liability (USD) | Labor rate cap (USD per hour) |
|---|---|---|---|
| KestrelCare Powertrain | 3500.00 | 7500.00 | 125.00 |
| KestrelCare Powertrain Plus | 5000.00 | 10000.00 | 135.00 |
| KestrelCare Silver | 6500.00 | 15000.00 | 150.00 |
| KestrelCare Gold | 8000.00 | 20000.00 | 160.00 |
| KestrelCare Platinum | 10000.00 | 30000.00 | 175.00 |
| KestrelCare Platinum Exclusionary | 15000.00 | 40000.00 | 195.00 |

The aggregate limit of liability is capped at the vehicle price on the purchase order.

| Coverage level | Diagnostic time paid when the resulting repair is covered | Deductible waived when the repair is done at a Kestrel network facility | Plan ends when the aggregate limit is used up |
|---|---|---|---|
| KestrelCare Powertrain | no | no | yes |
| KestrelCare Powertrain Plus | yes | no | yes |
| KestrelCare Silver | yes | no | yes |
| KestrelCare Gold | yes | yes | yes |
| KestrelCare Platinum | yes | yes | yes |
| KestrelCare Platinum Exclusionary | yes | yes | yes |

## Reading the card (hypothetical figures)

- A facility quotes 4 labor hours at 170.00 USD per hour on a KestrelCare Silver plan. The hours are recognized at no more than the 150.00 cap, so the labor recognized is 600.00 rather than 680.00.
- On a vehicle whose purchase order shows a vehicle price of 18500.00, a KestrelCare Platinum Exclusionary aggregate limit of 40000.00 is held to 18500.00; on a vehicle priced at 52000.00 it stays at 40000.00.
